data.name: Vibhuti
data.gender_notes: Vibhuti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vibhuti means the sacred ash used in Hindu rituals. It is a symbol of purity and holiness. The ash represents the five basic elements of life - earth, water, fire, air, and space. The name Vibhuti carries the meaning “Holiness, Purity, Sacred Ash” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vibhuti usually hope their child will grow to embody holiness, purity, sacred ash and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vibhuti is a spiritual symbol representing the divine presence in everything. It is a reminder of our connection to the universe and our inner divinity.
data.etymology: Vibhuti belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Holiness, Purity, Sacred Ash.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhuti total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: विभूति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vibhuti comes from the Sanskrit root word 'bhuti', which means 'to exist', 'to become', or 'to manifest'. The prefix 'vi-' in Vibhuti means 'all', 'entire', or 'completely'. So, Vibhuti can be translated to mean 'Divine Presence or Manifestation'. It is a name that represents the divine power and presence in all forms.

in_hindi.name: विभूति
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Vibhuti is used to refer to the sacred ash that is used as a mark of protection and blessings in Hinduism. It is also used as a name for a person who embodies the divine presence and blessings.

in_telugu.name: విభూటి
